rationale: The stock is trading at the extreme top of its intraday range (96th percentile) after a significant gap-down, indicating that the initial selling pressure has been fully absorbed but there is no fresh momentum to push through the recent highs. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward ratio due to the proximity to the session high and the lack of volume expansion in the last few minutes, while shorting against a strong recovery from the lows is counter-trend.
